description: Absolute <base href="{{site}}/foo/"> but the relative sheet only exists under the page directory (/css/a.css), not under the base (/foo/css/a.css).

thin.note: Spec <base href> handling: css/a.css resolves to /foo/css/a.css, which answers 404 on the page's own host, so the job fails like any other same-host stylesheet failure. critical falls back to probing the page directory (HEAD /foo/css/a.css 404, then GET /css/a.css) and includes the sheet from there: that guessing is what the new layer drops. See base-href-absolute-base-dir-not-found for the case where the sheet does exist under the base.
